GeneDef.label: Zoogastric obsession
GeneDef.description: This pawn adores being prey for animals. If it ever goes missing, make sure to check the bellies of all your livestock, pets, and the wildlife.

GeneDef.label: Zoogastric interest
GeneDef.description: This pawn likes being prey for animals. It's thrilling to be subject to the inscrutable whims of a beast, not knowing if it might change its mind about its safety, or when it'll decide to release it.

GeneDef.label: Zoogastric ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't mind being prey for animals, but doesn't prefer it either.

GeneDef.label: Zoogastric disinterest
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes being prey for animals. How certain can it be that the beast will listen to demands to be let out?

GeneDef.label: Zoogastric revulsion
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates being prey for animals and will never willingly be consumed by them. It's as disgusting as it is degrading.

GeneDef.label: Anthropogastric obsession
GeneDef.description: This pawn adores being prey for its fellow sapient beings. It is a prey of the people--any person, really.

GeneDef.label: Anthropogastric interest
GeneDef.description: This pawn likes being prey for its fellow sapient beings. It's nice to be able to socialize with its predator.

GeneDef.label: Anthropogastric ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't mind being prey for its fellow sapient beings, but doesn't prefer it either.

GeneDef.label: Anthropogastric disinterest
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes being prey for its fellow sapient beings. It can't escape the stresses of society by entering the body of a member of society.

GeneDef.label: Anthropogastric revulsion
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates being prey for its fellow sapient beings and will never willingly be consumed by them. That's at least three kinds of unnatural.

GeneDef.label: Entomogastric obsession
GeneDef.description: This pawn adores being prey for insectoids. There aren't many other ways for a humanoid to become one with the hive.

GeneDef.label: Entomogastric interest
GeneDef.description: This pawn likes being prey for insectoids. Such an alien physiology is quite fascinating to tour from the inside.

GeneDef.label: Entomogastric ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't mind being prey for insectoids, but doesn't prefer it either.

GeneDef.label: Entomogastric disinterest
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes being prey for insectoids. Bugs aren't known for eating their prey in one whole bite. Not swarms of them, at least...

GeneDef.label: Entomogastric revulsion
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates being prey for insectoids and will not willingly be consumed by them. No amount of showers would ever let it feel clean again.

GeneDef.label: Mechanogastric obsession
GeneDef.description: This pawn adores being prey for mechanoids. It is more at home among flexing hydraulics and humming circuits than the beat of most hearts.

GeneDef.label: Mechanogastric interest
GeneDef.description: This pawn likes being prey for mechanoids. Cold, unyielding plasteel makes for a unique and exhilarating experience.

GeneDef.label: Mechanogastric ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't mind being prey for mechanoids, but doesn't prefer it either.

GeneDef.label: Mechanogastric disinterest
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes being prey for mechanoids. Think of all the grinding gears! All the constant clicking and ticking!

GeneDef.label: Mechanogastric revulsion
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates being prey for mechanoids and will not willingly be consumed by them. Even if it was suicidal, that sure as hell ain't the way it wants to go out.

GeneDef.label: Exclusive Gynephile
GeneDef.description: This pawn exclusively prefers female predators, and will never willingly let itself be consumed by a man.

GeneDef.label: Gynephilic Tendencies
GeneDef.description: This pawn prefers female predators, but may make occasional exceptions.

GeneDef.label: Gender Indifferent
GeneDef.description: The gender of the predator is not a consideration for this pawn. Everyone looks the same on the inside!

GeneDef.label: Androphilic Tendencies
GeneDef.description: This pawn prefers male predators, but may make occasional exceptions.

GeneDef.label: Exclusive Androphile
GeneDef.description: This pawn exclusively prefers male predators, and will never willingly let itself be consumed by a woman.

GeneDef.label: Digestion-wish
GeneDef.description: As an obsessive aliment, this pawn just can't help it; it wants to be utterly digested.

GeneDef.label: Aliment
GeneDef.description: As an aliment, this pawn often thinks about getting digested someday.

GeneDef.label: Alimentary ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't really care one way or the other about being digested.

GeneDef.label: Alimentary aversion
GeneDef.description: This pawn is not particularly interested in an early, acidic grave.

GeneDef.label: Life-wish
GeneDef.description: Are you mad? Who would want to be digested alive? This pawn certainly doesn't.

GeneDef.label: Obsessive Godemichet
GeneDef.description: As an obsessive godemichet, this pawn lives to be used for pleasure, and seeks it in the bellies of predators.

GeneDef.label: Godemichet
GeneDef.description: As a godemichet, this pawn likes to get off deep inside someone just as much as shallowly.

GeneDef.label: Dildo ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't really care one way or the other about being used for a predator's pleasure.

GeneDef.label: Chaste prey
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes climbing into a predator for pleasure's sake. Maybe it's some sort of weirdo who doesn't find innards arousing?

GeneDef.label: Celibate prey
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates trying to find pleasure in the insides of a predator. It just can't get it on in there.

GeneDef.label: Shut-in prey
GeneDef.description: This pawn would rather live the rest of its life inside someone's belly than contribute to society in any way.

GeneDef.label: Live-in prey
GeneDef.description: Sometimes, this pawn just wants to take a vacation inside of someone. Or move in.

GeneDef.label: Live-in ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't really care one way or the other about being stored indefinitely.

GeneDef.label: Busy prey
GeneDef.description: If you have to eat this pawn, at least don't make it an extended stay. It has its own things to do.

GeneDef.label: In-and-out prey
GeneDef.description: This pawn cannot think of a life more boring than squishing around inside of a predator for days, months, or heaven forbid, years.

GeneDef.label: In-and-out prey
GeneDef.description: This pawn loves passing through and taking in the sights of its predators.

GeneDef.label: Live-in prey
GeneDef.description: Sometimes, this pawn just wants to take a vacation inside of someone. Or move in.

GeneDef.label: Hold ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't really care one way or the other about being held temporarily.

GeneDef.label: Busy prey
GeneDef.description: If you have to eat this pawn, at least don't make it an extended stay. It has its own things to do.

GeneDef.label: Unwilling
GeneDef.description: This pawn cannot think of a life more boring than squishing around inside of a predator for days, months, or heaven forbid, years.

GeneDef.label: Hypochondriac
GeneDef.description: This pawn always feels like they need to slip into someone to be healed, even when they are perfectly fine.

GeneDef.label: Cozy prey
GeneDef.description: This pawn prefers healing vore over an expensive trip to a spa.

GeneDef.label: Heal ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't really care one way or the other about being vored for health.

GeneDef.label: Uncomfortable prey
GeneDef.description: This pawn would prefer not being vored this way, even if it would be beneficial for their health.

GeneDef.label: Trypanophobia
GeneDef.description: This pawn would rather succumb to their injuries than allow itself to be used as a healing prey.
